component.name: Ulanzi Deck
component.summary: Set up your Ulanzi D200 and D200X stream decks

description.p: Ulanzi Deck configures the Ulanzi D200 and D200X stream decks on Linux. Drag actions onto keys, pick icons, logos, app icons or your own pictures, and see every change on the deck right away.

ul.li: Keys, dials, small buttons and the wide screen, with tap and hold actions
Media, volume, outputs, shortcuts, typing, commands, apps, websites and OBS Studio
Wide-screen widgets: clocks, system stats, Now Playing, timer, weather, command output, pictures and OBS
Profiles that switch with the app in front, pages and folders, undo and redo
Templates, import and export, and automatic backups
A small background service runs the deck with the window closed

screenshot.caption: Keys, dials and the wide screen
Wide-screen widgets with a live preview

description.p: A full rewrite in Rust with a new GTK interface: wide-screen widgets, OBS Studio control, profiles that follow the app in front, templates, import and export, and backups.
